title: The Terrible storm of that night
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：terrible　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 terrible 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the foreman wrote of ① a terrible storm of that night in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more terrible than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the terrible ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most terrible storm of that night anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too terrible to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the terrible ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a terrible mistake in the accounts, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as terrible as the mistake in the accounts they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was terrible or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something terrible, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite terrible; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the terrible ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, year after year, she wrote of another terrible storm of that night in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more terrible than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most terrible mistake in the accounts in the whole site, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the terrible ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可怕（前置定语 a terrible storm of that night：1977 年工头在施工单里记下的那件可怕的暴风雨）
B. adj. 可怕／糟糕（比较级 more terrible than：文中两处，一处比那夜可怕的暴风雨，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可怕／糟糕（最高级 the most terrible：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可怕（表语 too terrible to do：母亲觉得它太可怕，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 糟糕（前置定语 a terrible mistake in the accounts：叔叔把整件事称作一桩糟糕的错误）
F. adj. 糟糕（同级比较 as terrible as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩账上糟糕的错误相比）
G. adj. 糟糕（后置定语 something terrible：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 糟糕（受程度副词修饰 quite terrible：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a terrible storm of that night
the most terrible storm of that night anybody
a terrible mistake in the accounts
The most terrible mistake in the accounts in

answers.why: terrible 意为“可怕”，1977 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件可怕的暴风雨”，此处作前置定语 a terrible storm of that night。
terrible 意为“可怕”，此处用比较级 more terrible than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
terrible 意为“可怕”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最可怕的一件，故用最高级 the most terrible storm of that night。
terrible 意为“可怕”，母亲认为这件东西“太可怕了，谁也用不上”，too terrible to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩糟糕的错误”，此处作前置定语 a terrible mistake in the accounts。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩账上糟糕的错误一样糟糕”，同级比较用 as terrible as。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，施工单上那半行字要的是“糟糕的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something terrible。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当糟糕”，quite 修饰原级 terrible。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，1987 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要糟糕”，故用比较级 more terrible than。
terrible 意为“糟糕”，母亲 1989 年说的是“整个工地里最糟糕的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most terrible mistake in the accounts。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件可怕的暴风雨。（a terrible storm of that night）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可怕。（more terrible than …）
母亲觉得它太可怕，谁也用不上。（too terrible to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩糟糕的错误。（a terrible mistake in the accounts）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩账上糟糕的错误一样糟糕。（as terrible as …）
到了 1984 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件糟糕的东西。（something terrible）
answers: In 1977 the foreman wrote of a terrible storm of that night in the sheet.
Everybody said it was more terrible than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too terrible to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a terrible mistake in the accounts.
He said nobody would call it as terrible as the mistake in the accounts they had once had.
By 1984 the sheet asked for nothing but something terrible.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 terrible 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the foreman wrote of a terrible storm of that night in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most terrible storm of that night in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too terrible to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a terrible mistake in the accounts, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite terrible, and everybody laughed.
The terrible ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
